product_metadata.title: Bekith 5 Pack Gumdrop Jelly Molds, Chocolate Molds, Gummy Bear Candy Molds, 265 gummy bears total +5 Droppers
features: 265 Gumdrop Molds & 5 Dropper: The 5 trays have 53 bear molds each; The size of each tray are 6.5" x 6" x 0.5".
With a dropper the molds can be easily to fill. And also the flexible material makes it easy to clean. These make a great gift for children and friends.
Freezer, oven and dishwasher safe. Working temperature range is from -40 to 450 F.
Non-stick silicone mold that won't crack or break like stiff plastic molds; easy to fill, easy to use, easy to clean. These cute little bears are mini in size.

Multi-functional Use: making candy or other treats for the upcoming holiday. Perfect to make gummy bears, chocolate treats, candy bears, jelly, Ice cubes and mix your own ingredients for a healthy alternative snacks.
